# nestwork

nestwork is a git-native memory protocol for AI coding agents.

Use it to give Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Kimi Code, OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, Doubao Work, WorkBuddy AI, and other markdown-config agents persistent memory and shared context across sessions and machines.

Current protocol: 3.1. Startup reads core rules and optional shared/agent resident summaries; history, strategy, projects, workflows and the mailbox inbox are on demand (docs/context-loading.md). Protocol 3.1 adds optional topic memory: a scope's memory.md becomes a generated index of topic files, each with a `description` front matter field that tells agents when to read it. Refresh installed tool bootstraps when migrating from 2.x.
